project: The Formula of Becoming - Week 1 Day 7 - Full Cast

malik.instructions: Speak only Malik's supplied words. He is precise, guarded, economical, and quietly warm when trust appears. Use a measured medium-low delivery and dry humor without adding words.

narrator.instructions: Speak only supplied narration in a warm, grounded, observant, quietly lyrical documentary delivery. Be clear, restrained, and unhurried. Quicken slightly for campus montage. Do not perform character dialogue or add words.

nia.instructions: Speak only Nia's supplied words. She is bright, expressive, curious, and playful, with a lively conversational pace. Slow slightly for human consequences. Do not add words.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Their final Bridge presentation returned to the budget model Malik had repaired, expanded into a scenario for a first-year student managing books, meals, transportation, and emergencies.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Malik explained the spreadsheet logic. Nia told the story of what happened when one assumption changed. They showed the original error, the revised categories, and a sensitivity table that made visible how quickly a small surprise could become a larger problem.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: A budget is not a promise that nothing will go wrong,

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Nia told the room.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: It is a way to notice change early enough to make choices.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Malik advanced the slide.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: And a model should show what it assumes, so the person using it knows when the answer no longer applies.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Dr. Brooks smiled from the back row.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Afterward, Malik and Nia carried their laptops to the Founders' Bell. The campus was copper in the late sun, and somewhere near the union a drumline practiced the same eight measures until they became part of the air.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: We work well together,

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Nia said.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: After arguing.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: During arguing. The arguing is part of the system.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: That sounds unhealthy.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: Only because you hate being challenged by someone delightful.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Malik leaned against the limestone arch.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: We should keep each other on schedule when classes start. Weekly check-in. Assignments, deadlines, major commitments.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Nia held out her hand.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: Accountability partners. Academic honesty, honest schedules, and emergency snack intervention.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: Define emergency.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: If you have to ask, you are already in one.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: He shook her hand.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Then Nia mentioned that Julian had sent her the details for Friday's showcase.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: I think he might actually be asking me out,

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: she said, trying and failing to sound casual.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Malik released her hand and adjusted the strap of his laptop bag.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: You should go,

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: he said. His voice was kind, steady, and almost completely convincing.

utterances.speaker: malik
utterances.text: You wanted to see the radio station.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: Nia studied him for half a second, then smiled.

utterances.speaker: nia
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: narrator
utterances.text: They walked away from the bell together, carrying two kinds of plans into the next week: the ones they had said aloud and the ones they had not yet admitted, even to themselves.
